## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmation: (1) sector mix with Energy/Utilities showing strength while Technology and Financials lag, (2) Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) so no clear risk-on or risk-off tilt.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: PSX (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +25.53%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +11.54%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +6.94% | 1M: +10.58%) ABOVE TREND.  
Healthcare strong: ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +3.06% | 1M: +6.06%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: GOOGL (1W: -7.77% | 1M: -2.17%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -7.95% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.63%) CORRECTION.  
Financials mixed/soft: JPM (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +5.52%) ABOVE TREND but sector 1W negative; monitor breadth. Communication mixed: WBD (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +5.65%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +25.53%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +5.65%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +13.13%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +6.94% | 1M: +10.58%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors represented).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: WBD (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -5.29% | 1M: +17.07%) CORRECTION, GE (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -6.87% | 1M: +4.24%) CORRECTION, NFLX (1W: -6.99% | 1M: -5.97%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Tech/Comm; Leadership: Narrow (2 sectors dominate Top 5 laggards).

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +25.53%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +5.65%) ABOVE TREND; note FCX (1W: +6.61% | 1M: -5.85%) RECOVERY and CEG (1W: +6.50% | 1M: -0.23%) RECOVERY — there is MAJOR divergence across large caps (AAPL, MSFT, META, AMZN showing 1W vs 1M mismatch), so watch for trend breaks rather than broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed, more corrective than constructive: AAPL (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +9.72%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +6.26%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.63%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -7.77% | 1M: -2.17%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: Tech: 6/24 positive (internal rotation and profit-taking).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Mixed/transitionary: JPM (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +5.52%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +8.21%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +10.08%) CORRECTION — Sector breadth: Financials: 8/20 positive (rotation, selective bank strength rather than broad risk-on).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Defensive-to-cyclical mix: ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -15.45%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: Healthcare: 12/17 positive (leadership but watch isolated large drawdowns).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy and select Healthcare exposure given clear ABOVE TREND names (PSX, XOM, ABT) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND (GOOGL, NFLX, ISRG) until trend confirmation; style mixed/no clear leadership — be selective and size defensively.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: ABT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +25.53%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +11.54%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -7.77% | 1M: -2.17%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -15.45%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -7.95% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (9/10 positive) and Utilities (7/10 positive) — momentum confirmed.  
BEARISH: Technology (6/24 positive) and parts of Financials (8/20 positive) — monitor for further rotation or re-acceleration.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA 900 resistance (CORRECTION test); AAPL 180 support (CORRECTION base); JPM 200 breakout level for continuation (ABOVE TREND); XOM 120 hold as confirmation of Energy leadership (ABOVE TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
MMM (+80): MMM (1W: +6.37% | 1M: +4.62%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming after raised guidance.  
NOW (+80): NOW (1W: -8.85% | 1M: +2.63%) CORRECTION — strong AI-driven outlook but price falling, a divergence to watch.  
WBD (+90): WBD (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND — EU deal approval but price falling, distribution signal.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
LLY (-60): LLY (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines on legal/competitive risk but price remains elevated, watch for follow-through.  
ISRG (-50): ISRG (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -15.45%) BELOW TREND — analyst cuts confirming downside; sentiment and price aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Energy and Healthcare names showing strength — ABT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +15.32%), PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +25.53%). Key risk: major divergence across large caps (AAPL, MSFT, META in CORRECTION) and several bullish headlines (WBD, NOW) diverging from price — watch for trend break before re-leveraging.
